Draft · 24.10.2026

TsBST and ROY.MARKET a Moscow non-profit, its military marketplace, and the drone-war supply around it

An open-source investigation of ANO «TsBST», a Moscow non-profit for the drone industry, and of the companies, products, sales and handovers to military units that connect to it. Every claim rests on an archived document and is graded by how well that document shows it.

A strike, then a sales line

  1. 8 OctoberZaporizhzhiaThe head of the regional administration reports that an FPV drone hit the coat of arms on its building.Reported
  2. neither post dates the strike
  3. 19 OctoberGagaringThe maker posts a video of “the results” of its Kuznechik and Sova 5.8.Reported
  4. same video
  5. 20 OctoberTsBSTRe-posts it as “a TsBST resident showed footage of the strike” and names both products.Reported
  6. sales line
  7. Order lineROY.MARKET“Servicemen can order them” there. The catalogue is behind a login, so TsBST's post is the only evidence.Reported

On 19 October 2026 OOO «Gagaring»RussianООО «Гагаринг», a drone-electronics maker in Krasnodar, posted a short video to its Telegram channel:

Translation“And here is footage of the results of the Kuznechik and Sova 5.8 duo at work. […] The Zaporizhzhia administration's trident has come unstuck.”RussianА вот кадры результатов работы дуэта Кузнечика и Совы 5.8. […] У Запорожской администрации тризуб отклеился.Gagaring, Telegram, 19.10.20261

The next morning TsBST, the Moscow non-profit for the drone industry that counts the company among its residents2, posted the same video under its own headline, named the two products used, and closed with a sales line:

Translation“The trident came unstuck”: a TsBST resident showed footage of the strike on the Ukrainian administration of Zaporizhzhia […] The strike was carried out by a kamikaze drone using the «Kuznechik» communication system and the «Sova 5.8» remote video receiver. […] Servicemen can order them on ROY.MARKET, the specialised platform for dual-use goods.”Russian«Тризуб отклеился»: резидент ЦБСТ показал кадры удара по украинской администрации Запорожья […] Удар осуществлялся дроном-камикадзе с применением системы связи «Кузнечик» и выносного видеоприёмника «Сова 5.8». […] Военнослужащие могут заказать их на специализированной платформе товаров двойного назначения РОЙ.МАРКЕТ.TsBST, Telegram, 20.10.20263

TsBST calls the city “occupied”. Zaporizhzhia is held by Ukraine; the building is the seat of its regional government. On 8 October the head of the regional administration reported that an FPV drone had hit the coat of arms on its façade: smoke, no fire, nobody hurt4. ROY.MARKET is TsBST's own marketplace for military units. No sanctions listing for the maker is on file.

Reported Both posts are the parties' own word. We watched the 25-second video. It follows a drone in over a large government building, labelled “Kuznechik/Sova 5.8”, down to a trident coat of arms on its façade; the last eight seconds are a separate vertical clip, with its own watermark, of the coat of arms hanging damaged from its frame. That is consistent with the report of 8 October, but neither post dates the strike, we have not placed the building on a map, and the impact itself is not in the frames we checked.

TsBST's “dual-use” is the platform's own label. From August 2026 its page for prospective sellers opened with “ROY.MARKET is a secure sales channel for dual-use goods.”RussianРОЙ.МАРКЕТ - защищённый канал продаж товаров двойного назначения.5 The copy archived on 12 October still did6. By 24 October the same sentence read “ROY.MARKET is a secure sales channel for special-purpose goods.”RussianРОЙ.МАРКЕТ - защищённый канал продаж товаров специального назначения.7 The kamikaze drone in TsBST's post used the two products it advertises; the platform's public terms and buyer offer use neither phrase.

Who stands behind TsBST

The seller in that post is not an ordinary shop. TsBST's co-founders on the company register are a donor foundation and a state-owned bank; TsBST names the ruling party as a third, and the head of the party's central executive committee is secretary of its supervisory board.

Translation“TsBST together with United Russia and the Nasha Pravda foundation delivered thousands of items to the front for destroying the enemy. […] Together with the party and PSB we launched the military marketplace «Roymarket». The platform has been tested.”RussianЦБСТ вместе с Единой Россией и фондом «Наша правда» поставили на фронт тысячи изделий для уничтожения врага. […] Вместе с партией и ПСБ запустили военный маркетплейс «Роймаркет». Платформа протестирована.Aleksandr SidyakinRussianАлександр Геннадьевич Сидякин, secretary of TsBST's supervisory board and head of United Russia's central executive committee, on TsBST's year, Telegram, 15.12.20258

The front it supplies

In May 2025 the UN's Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine concluded that Russian drone operators on the left bank of the Dnipro had spent ten months attacking civilians in Kherson, and that the attacks amount to the crime against humanity of murder23. In October it extended the finding to 300 km of the river and three regions, and named the formation the operators serve in:

Quotation“They are affiliated with various army units, all of which are part of the “Dnepr” Group of Forces”UN report A/80/497, para. 40, 21.10.202524

The Commission names the 18th Combined Arms Army; it names no brigade. The Centre for Information Resilience and DW named the 205th among three units whose drones were at work over Beryslav during the attacks there, and said they could not prove who carried them out25. The 205th is a motor-rifle brigade; the channel that posts its footage, under the brigade's emblem, places it in the 49th Army26. A senior doctor at a Kherson hospital told the Commission:

Quotation“Russian Federation soldiers behave like this is a safari […]; they are simply chasing and hunting civilians who are on their way to work or walking their dogs.”UN paper A/HRC/59/CRP.2, para. 42, 28.05.202523

What TsBST's circle says about that front

  • «Arkhangel» drone schoolTsBST's own channel says a resident's anti-drone simulator runs at the school's training centre in Tuapse27. The school's channel recruits operators for the 205th brigade28, which it calls “the terror of Kherson region”29. The school says it trains within Bars-Sarmat, Dmitry Rogozin's drone centre30.Not documented
  • Bars-SarmatIts commander, Dmitry Rogozin, says the centre fights for the commander of the Airborne Forces and that units of the «Dnepr» Group of Forces fit its munitions to their assault drones3132.Reported
  • Fond «Nasha Pravda»RussianФонд «Наша Правда»reports delivering 100 strike drones to fighters of the 49th Army on the Kherson direction in May 202433, and a vehicle now used by the 18th Army to move cargo and troops to the front line34.Reported
  • OOO «Gagaring»RussianООО «Гагаринг»the maker of the Kuznechik and Sova posts thanks from 49th Army air-defence crews who use the Sova to intercept drone video over the Dnipro35.Reported
Translation“Sign a contract with the Ministry of Defence and go on to serve in the drone unit of the 205th Guards Separate Motor Rifle Brigade. […] The final exam is your first combat mission, in which, under the eye of strict instructors, you will hit your first target.”RussianЗаключай контракт с Министерством обороны и неси дальнейшую службу в подразделении БПЛА 205-ой Гв ОМСБр. […] Выпускной экзамен - это Твое первое боевое задание, на котором Ты под присмотром строгих инструкторов поразишь свою первую цель.«Arkhangel», Telegram, 01.12.202528

What the units say about their targets

The Commission reproduces posts of a Kherson-front channel, «From Mariupol to the Carpathians», as figures in its paper23. The channel signs its strike videos with the units' names. Under footage of the 205th brigade:

Translation“Beryslav sector of the front. The men of steel of the 205th brigade, 49th Combined Arms Army, «Dnepr» Group of Forces, at work […] Any movement of vehicles will be considered a legitimate target. All objects of critical infrastructure are a legitimate target.”RussianБериславский отрезок фронта. Работают мужчины из стали 205 бригада 49 ОА ГВ "Днепр" […] Любое передвижение автотранспорта будет считаться законной целью. Все объекты критической инфраструктуры являются законной целью.«From Mariupol to the Carpathians», Telegram, 23.07.202526

Under a video of a van being struck in a residential yard:

Translation“The operators worked precisely, as they observed civilians nearby. Do not stay near vehicles, do not move about in the red zone. All vehicles will be destroyed.”RussianОператоры работали точечно, так как наблюдали поблизости гражданских. Не находитесь рядом с автотранспортом, не передвигайтесь в красной зоне. Вся техника будет уничтожена.the same channel, 19.08.202436

And under the heading the platform used for its sellers:

Translation“Dual-use transport. Once again the enemy is using ambulances to bring up ammunition […] Naturally, the vehicles will be destroyed and are being destroyed.”RussianТранспорт двойного назначения. Противник в очередной раз использует кареты скорой помощи для подвоза БК […] Естественно, техника будет уничтожаться и уничтожается.the same channel, 24.07.202637
Translation“Dual-use transport. The «Rodnoy» crew spotted a vehicle moving through the Red Zone in the guise of funeral services.”RussianТранспорт двойного назначения. Расчет Родной выявил технику, которая перемещается по Красной зоне под видом ритуальных услуг.the same channel, 24.10.2026, over a clip watermarked by the 98th Airborne Division38

Reported The ties above are the parties' own posts. They show TsBST's circle supplying and recruiting for the formations the UN names; they do not show that any item from it was used against civilians, and the UN names no unit below the army.

More than a marketplace

TsBST presents itself as a support body for drone makers, and ROY.MARKET as a catalogue. Its own posts and its board secretary's describe more than that. It says it showed the marketplace at «Tsentr-2026», a strategic military exercise with delegations from 41 countries, and signed up sellers there:

Translation“The exercise was visited by the President of Russia, Vladimir Putin. […] During the exhibition, TsBST representatives agreed with more than 10 participants to place their range on the ROY.MARKET platform.”RussianУчения посетил Президент России Владимир Путин. […] В ходе выставки представители ЦБСТ договорились более чем с 10 участниками о размещении их ассортимента на платформе РОЙ.МАРКЕТ.TsBST, Telegram, 04.10.202639

On 15 October its board secretary, the United Russia official Aleksandr SidyakinRussianАлександр Геннадьевич Сидякин, announced an app that assigns incoming Ukrainian drones to mobile fire teams in Kursk region, and placed it inside a TsBST system:

Translation“This is part of the «Yakim» system, which was developed by TsBST and has been helping to control the region's airspace for a year now. […] In future we plan to link «Yakim» with the military system «Svod» for better analysis of the situation. We also want to connect automatic machine-gun turrets”RussianЭто часть системы «Яким», которая разработана ЦБСТ и уже год помогает контролировать воздушное пространство региона. […] В будущем планируем связать «Яким» с военной системой «Свод» для лучшего анализа ситуации. Также хотим подключить автоматические пулемётные турелиSidyakin, Telegram, 15.10.202640

Reported Both are the parties' own claims; no document on file shows the system in service.

The network on file

The investigation's registry links 70 organisations to TsBST: 60 through a document (a register entry, a contract, TsBST's own posts), 10 on their own word or press reports alone. 25 of them are on at least one sanctions list. Counted from the registry on 24.10.2026.

How we found it

We did not set out to investigate TsBST. We were following military goods on a consumer marketplace, and a new marketplace came looking for the same sellers.

  1. We had been watching Wildberries

    The investigation started as WB Watch, a tracker of military goods sold on Russia's largest consumer marketplace. It found a large, open trade in kit for the war.

    7,666military-item listings
    89%shipped from Wildberries' own warehouses
    802sellers

  2. Then a military marketplace announced itself

    In December 2025 Sidyakin wrote that the party, Bank PSB and TsBST had launched a military marketplace. In August 2026 the platform opened to outside sellers and named the ones it wanted first.

    Translation“The online marketplace ROY.MARKET has opened a protected sales channel for manufacturers, distributors and professional sellers of dual-use goods. First of all it invites legal entities already working on Wildberries, Ozon and other universal marketplaces.”RussianОнлайн-маркетплейс РОЙ.МАРКЕТ открыл защищённый канал продаж для производителей, дистрибьюторов и профессиональных селлеров товаров двойного назначения. В первую очередь площадка приглашает к сотрудничеству юрлица, которые уже работают на Wildberries, Ozon и других универсальных маркетплейсах.ROY.MARKET's announcement, 13.08.202663

    Its target was the seller base we had already mapped.

  3. The site hid its operator. An older copy did not

    The platform's public terms print the operator as “OOO «****»”. A copy archived on 22.08.2026 names it: OOO «MPTM»RussianООО «МПТМ», INN 9714068459. TsBST's own report to the Justice Ministry lists the same company as one it has taken part in since the day it was registered.

    Lines as printed in each document, rendered in English; the Russian original is under RU. The masked version shows the requisites only after login.

  4. First guess: the usual sellers, plus TsBST's residents

    If the platform recruits Wildberries sellers, and TsBST runs a residency for drone makers, the likely suppliers are makers that are both. We checked every maker on file against the Wildberries sellers by INN.

  5. The check missed the best case

    «Bulat», a drone detector shown at Dronnitsa 2025, a showcase TsBST takes part in, returned nothing: no Wildberries seller carries its maker's INN. The detector is on sale all the same, through dealers and sole traders. A sanctions screen keyed on the maker's identifier would make the same mistake.

  6. The marketplace is one outlet among several

    Asked whether the new «Bulat» would go on ROY.MARKET, 3mx answered:

    Translation“All our products can be bought only from us on the site 3mx.ru or from our dealers.”RussianВсю нашу продукцию можно приобрести только у нас на сайте 3mx.ru или у наших дилеров.3mx, in its customer chat, 02.09.202671

    The detector reaches units another way: a foundation that co-founded TsBST buys it and posts the handovers. So we stopped following the platform and started following products, from the maker to the people who receive them.

How to read the evidence

  • Documented A primary document shows it: a register extract, a state contract, an annual filing, a trademark or patent record.
  • Reported One party's own word (its posts, its website, its listings), or the press. Donors' handover posts are graded here until a second source confirms them.
  • Not documented Drawn to complete the picture, but no document on file shows it. The line's own note says what is missing.

Red marks only a sanctions listing, and always names the regimes. Names appear as registered, in Russian; a company known by its brand is shown by the brand, with the registered name beneath it.

How this is made

  • Facts come from the original Russian documents, read in full: company register extracts, annual accounts, procurement records, trademark records, court filings and the parties' own Telegram posts and websites. Summaries and machine translations are leads, never sources.
  • Every document is archived and hashed when it is collected. Each note at the end of a page says what the document is and links to it where a public copy exists.
  • Pictures are evidence only for what they show, and each says who published it. Faces of people taking part are shown; nobody is named from a face.

What this does not show

  • A handover to a unit does not show that the equipment was used in combat. Some recipients are rear units.
  • TsBST's share in the company that runs ROY.MARKET is not stated in any document on file, and since 15.07.2026 the company register withholds who owns that company73.
  • A US sanctions entry under a similar name belongs to a different company registered in Tula. TsBST itself is not shown here as sanctioned by the US.
  • This is a draft. The earlier case studies and company profiles were withdrawn while the site is rebuilt around chain views.
